seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Cypress, CA 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Cypress, California for 2026: Holiday Sing with train rides and Santa, library crafts and La Palma's tree lighting.
lede: Cypress gathers the family on the Civic Center Green on December 1 for school choirs, Santa and train rides, with library crafts and La Palma's tree lighting close behind.
celebrates: Cypress centers its Christmas on the Civic Center. The city's Holiday Sing and Tree Lighting on Tuesday, December 1, fills the Civic Center Green with school performances, Santa and Mrs. Claus, train rides, games and crafts. The Cypress Library adds Winter Holidays Pop-Up Cards on December 10 and Carolers and Crafts on December 14. Neighboring La Palma, which has no page of its own on our site, holds its Holiday Tree Lighting and Santa's Village in Central Park on December 2 and a Kids Crafternoon at its library on December 9, so we list both here.
lastyear: The City of Cypress keeps a 31 photo gallery titled Holiday Sing 2025 on its event page, showing last year's evening on the Civic Center Green. The 2026 Holiday Sing keeps the same Tuesday evening format, with performances from local schools, Santa and Mrs. Claus, train rides and holiday crafts. In La Palma, the city's own post for an earlier year called its tree lighting the 38th annual ceremony, held on Wednesday, December 4, with the tree lighting at 5:30 pm in Central Park.
facts: The City of Cypress says the Holiday Sing is festival seating, so chairs and blankets are recommended, and it offers hot chocolate and cookies while supplies last. Families can also write letters to Santa and cards to veterans on site. A school performance line up is linked from the event page, and free parking is available in the Civic Center lot. La Palma's tree lighting is organized with its Community Activities and Beautification Committee.
trains: Cypress's Holiday Sing lists train rides on the Civic Center Green on December 1, one of the few train rides in this part of Orange County confirmed by a host for 2026. For a bigger day on the rails, our Anaheim guide covers Holidays at the Disneyland Resort. Irvine Park Railroad in Orange also says its Santa's Village runs from November 27 to December 30, with a Christmas Train that tickets must be bought for in advance.
traditions: The city's school choirs, Santa and Mrs. Claus, train rides and crafts on the Civic Center Green.

faq: When is the Cypress Holiday Sing in 2026?
Tuesday, December 1, 2026, at 6 pm on the Civic Center Green, at the corner of Orange Ave and Grindlay St.
Are there train rides in Cypress?
Yes. The City of Cypress lists train rides at the Holiday Sing, along with visits with Santa and Mrs. Claus.
Do we need to bring seating?
The city calls it festival seating and recommends chairs and blankets. Free parking is in the Civic Center lot.
Is there a tree lighting in La Palma?
Yes. La Palma's Holiday Tree Lighting is Wednesday, December 2, with Santa's Village at 4:30 pm and the lighting at 5:30 pm in Central Park, 7821 Walker St.
What library programs are in Cypress?
Winter Holidays Pop-Up Cards on December 10 and Carolers and Crafts on December 14 at the Cypress Library, 5331 Orange Ave.
